movers.headline: completes a **Rs 2,100 crore QIP** at Rs 2,110 a share, the first leg of a **Rs 3,850 crore raise** whose Rs 1,750 crore promoter-warrant half is still subject to approvals
agrees to merge into **ITC Infotech**, which is buying founder Ashok Soota's **22.106% holding for Rs 1,329.72 crore** and will issue 25 of its shares for every 81 held by others
**GRT Jewellers signs a share purchase agreement for the promoters' 74.12% stake at up to Rs 1,033.71 crore**, and will follow it with an open offer for about 26% more
signs a **binding term sheet worth about Rs 1,000 crore** with an India-based sovereign AI company for NVIDIA Blackwell cloud GPUs and allied services, running to June 2029
reports **three Buildings-division orders received during August totalling Rs 430.19 crore** excluding GST, none of them internal or related-party work
receives **orders totalling Rs 398.81 crore** for power distribution systems — from Princeton Digital Group's India management arm over 18 months, and from Classic Electric over six to eight months
approves a **Rs 300 crore tender-offer buyback of up to 20,68,965 shares at Rs 1,450**, 2.11% of capital, with 4 September fixed as the record date
approves **60,82,600 warrants at Rs 475 each, Rs 288.92 crore**, to its promoters and promoter group on a preferential basis, subject to shareholder approval
approves a **Rs 189.10 crore preferential issue of 31,00,000 warrants** at Rs 610 each to eight named non-promoters including Sukumar Srinivas, subject to shareholder approval
receives a **Letter of Award from Waaree Renewable Technologies worth Rs 55 crore** for five power transformers — three of 170/175 MVA and two of 125 MVA — for delivery by April 2027
completes the **Rs 40 crore purchase of 20% of Celloraa Energy**, making it an associate; this is the first tranche of a 50% investment for Rs 160 crore intimated on 29 June
approves a **preferential issue of 15,00,000 equity shares at Rs 212 each**, a fresh-equity raise of about Rs 31.80 crore including a Rs 207 premium
books **two LT-cable orders worth Rs 17.45 crore** — Rs 8.97 crore from a Tata Power-Government of Odisha joint venture and Rs 8.48 crore from an undisclosed state discom
wins a **Rs 17.02 crore letter of award from Madhya Pradesh Public Health Services Corporation** to supply 29,88,220 baby diapers to state government hospitals within 18 months, GST included
receives a **Rs 12.78 crore work order from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation** for laying, erecting and commissioning 66 kV XLPE cable in the Rajkot zone, over 24 months

order_wins: **E2E Networks** — a **binding term sheet of about Rs 1,000 crore** with an unnamed India-based sovereign AI company for NVIDIA Blackwell cloud GPUs and allied services, valid to June 2029 _(~7.9% of mcap)_.
**NCC** — **three orders totalling Rs 430.19 crore** excluding GST received during August for its Buildings division, none internal and none from related parties _(~4.6% of mcap)_.

**Marine Electricals (India)** — **orders aggregating Rs 398.81 crore** excluding taxes for power distribution systems, from Princeton Digital Group (India) Management over 18 months and Classic Electric over six to eight months _(~7.0% of mcap)_.

**Indo Tech Transformers** — a **Rs 55 crore Letter of Award from Waaree Renewable Technologies** for three 170/175 MVA and two 125 MVA power transformers, all five due between January and April 2027 _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Exato Technologies** — a consolidated disclosure of **Rs 22.37 crore of work orders received across July and August**, of which a USD 4,79,375 order (Rs 4.56 crore) had already been disclosed.

**Raaj Medisafe India** — a **Rs 17.02 crore letter of award from Madhya Pradesh Public Health Services Corporation** for 29,88,220 small baby diapers for state government hospitals, within 18 months and inclusive of GST _(~11.2% of mcap)_.

**HEC Infra Projects** — a **Rs 12.78 crore work order from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation** for laying, erecting, testing and commissioning 66 kV XLPE cable for the Rajkot zone, over 24 months _(~10.0% of mcap)_.
**Prime Cable Industries** — a **rate contract worth Rs 8,96,72,565.94** for LT cables from a joint venture of Tata Power and the Government of Odisha _(~2.4% of mcap)_.

**Prime Cable Industries** — a second order the same afternoon: a **Rs 8,48,42,000 purchase order** for LT cables from an undisclosed state distribution company, inclusive of GST, over four months _(~2.3% of mcap)_.
**Fascinate Textiles** — a confirmed **export order book of approximately Rs 12 crore** for execution over the four months from September to December 2026 _(~9.3% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**TechEra Engineering (India)** — a **Rs 5,00,66,400 purchase order** from an unnamed Indian public-sector aerospace and defence company for insourced structural assembly and supply of the HTT-40 front fuselage and coupling, over 24 months _(~1.8% of mcap)_.

**NLC India** — a **Letter of Intent from the Government of Telangana for a composite licence** over the Govindpur and Parvathapur vanadium, titanium and aluminous laterite blocks, won as preferred bidder in the seventh critical-minerals auction.

**Midwest** — accepts **letters of intent from the Andhra Pradesh Mineral Development Corporation** to work three granite quarry leases on a raising-cum-sale basis; the letters state no contract value.

**EMS Limited** — declares **Highest Bidder (H-1) status from NHAI** for user-fee collection at the Varshamedi plaza on NH-341 in Gujarat, an estimated Rs 28.39 crore over one year; the Letter of Award is still to come _(~1.4% of mcap)_.
**Sadhav Shipping** — a charter party agreement with **Lamprell Energy, UAE** for the vessel Adwita at **USD 7,900 a day** plus GST, for an initial 120 days extendable by a further 56.

**Transformers and Rectifiers (India)** — its revised press release names the end customer behind the Megha Engineering order published on 29 August: **generator transformers for NPCIL's Kaiga Units 5 & 6**, its first nuclear-sector order; no value is restated.

**AHAsolar Technologies** — a work order from **NLC India Renewables** to act as consultant for a 600 MW solar project with a 300 MW / 1,800 MWh storage system in Rajasthan, over 27 months; the order's own size is stated as confidential.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Piramal Finance** — completes a **Rs 2,100 crore QIP**, allotting 99,52,606 equity shares at Rs 2,110 to investors including ICICI Prudential, Nippon India, Kotak, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs Asset Management _(~4.1% of mcap)_.

**Kiri Industries** — a preferential issue of **60,82,600 warrants at Rs 475**, a premium of Rs 465, aggregating **Rs 288.92 crore**, to the promoters and promoter group, subject to shareholder approval _(~9.0% of mcap)_.

**Apollo Pipes** — a preferential issue of **31,00,000 fully convertible warrants at Rs 610**, aggregating **Rs 189.10 crore**, to eight non-promoters including AGDG Enterprises LLP and Sukumar Srinivas, convertible within 18 months and subject to shareholder approval.

**Wheels India** — re-prices the **Rs 180 crore preferential issue approved on 19 August from Rs 1,418 to Rs 1,461 a share**, and cuts the share count, after NSE queried the valuation _(~4.8% of mcap)_.
**Kross** — approves issuing **15,00,000 equity shares of Rs 5 at Rs 212**, a premium of Rs 207 a share and about **Rs 31.80 crore** of fresh equity on our arithmetic _(~2.3% of mcap)_.
**Ganga Bath Fittings** — approves a **rights issue of up to Rs 17.00 crore** and the draft letter of offer to be filed with SEBI and the exchanges; the record date is to follow _(~35.7% of mcap)_.
**JMJ Fintech** — its board approves the **postponement and withdrawal of its proposed preferential issue** of equity shares, on review of the status of the transaction.
equity_allotments: **Neetu Yoshi** — a revised disclosure of its **27 August** board approval, filed at the exchange's request: **26,42,400 warrants at Rs 104**, convertible into equity shares of Rs 5, to promoters and non-promoters on a preferential basis.

**Afcom Holdings** — converts **2,00,000 of the 11,65,000 warrants issued at Rs 863.17 in December 2025** into equity, two holders having paid the remaining 75% of the issue price: a past conversion completing.
**Zee Entertainment** — corrects its **27 August** preferential warrant disclosure: the proposed allottee's post-conversion holding should read **2.01%, not 1.40%**; all other details stand.
**Orchasp** — approves converting a loan owed to a **promoter-group lender** into up to **1,50,00,000 equity shares of Rs 2 at Rs 4.74**, a premium of Rs 2.74: dues extinguished, not new cash.
**Trident Lifeline** — completes a **past warrant conversion** from the 9,94,200 fully convertible warrants issued at Rs 266 on a preferential basis in June 2025, not new capital.

**Z-Tech (India)** — receives NSE in-principle approval to list **1,07,000 equity shares of Rs 10** allotted on 13 August on conversion of preferential warrants: a past conversion completing, not new capital.
m_and_a: **Happiest Minds Technologies** — its promoters sell **22.106% to ITC Infotech for Rs 1,329.72 crore** at Rs 390 and Rs 400 across two tranches, and the board approves amalgamating the company into ITC Infotech at 25 shares for 81 _(~21.4% of mcap)_.
**ITC** — confirms from the buyer's side that wholly owned **ITC Infotech will acquire 22.106% of Happiest Minds and then absorb it**, with ITC Infotech's own shares to be listed on both exchanges.

**Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri** — **GRT Jewellers signs an SPA for the promoters' 74.12% stake at up to Rs 1,033.71 crore** and will launch an open offer for about 26% more _(~50.7% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Lux Industries** — approves a **scheme of arrangement demerging its Vertical A and Vertical C businesses** into Lux and Cozi and Lux Global, two wholly owned subsidiaries incorporated in May for the purpose.

**Neogen Chemicals** — wholly owned Neogen Ionics agrees to transfer an undertaking to its own subsidiary Neogen Morita New Materials for a **lump sum Rs 245 crore**: an intra-group transfer, not an external deal.

**Capital India Finance** — sells the assets of its **RemitX foreign-exchange business to Kanji Forex for Rs 11.40 crore**, expects to complete by 31 October and will then surrender its AD Category-II licence.
**Lodha Developers** — acquires the **remaining 20% of Bellissimo Infratech**, making it wholly owned; the target had a net worth of Rs 97.30 crore and no turnover at 31 March 2026.

**Tata Steel** — completes the sale of **100% of Jamshedpur Football and Sporting to Churchill Brothers Sports Club**, whose share purchase agreement it disclosed on 14 August; no consideration is stated.
**Mankind Pharma** — completes the transfer of its **100% stake in Broadway Hospitality Services to AKRK Projects LLP and its partners**, intimated on 11 July; Broadway ceases to be a subsidiary.

**International Gemological Institute** — its Dubai step-down subsidiary approves **consolidating control of IGI Botswana**, a diamond grading and certification laboratory, which becomes wholly owned subject to regulatory approvals.

**Welspun Living** — **calls off the Rs 7.60 crore purchase of 26% of Clean Max Dhyuthi** from promoter-group Welspun Corp, approved in May, citing power demand, supply and availability at the location.
**Swelect Energy Systems** — transfers **26% of wholly owned ESG Solar Energy to Garg Acrylics**, a proposed group-captive consumer, leaving ESG Solar a subsidiary rather than wholly owned.

**Starlineps Enterprises** — completes the acquisition of 6,250 shares, **20% of Celloraa Energy, for Rs 40 crore**, making it an associate; a 50% subscription for Rs 160 crore was intimated on 29 June _(~11.1% of mcap)_.

**Muthoot Finance** — its board approves a **scheme of amalgamation of Muthoot Money**, a wholly owned subsidiary, into the company under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act; no swap ratio arises.

**Aar Shyam India Investment** — a **Detailed Public Statement for an open offer** for up to 58,43,327 shares, 26% of the emerging paid-up capital, by Radha Krishna Avudari, Sudha Rani Avudari and Nagabhyru Srikanth.
**Veranda Learning Solutions** — **Rs 37.50 crore of authorised share capital** merges into its own under the now-effective composite scheme, lifting authorised capital to Rs 147.50 crore.

**IIRM Holdings India** — its wholly owned IIRM Global Shared Services allots it 29,98,385 shares at Rs 116, converting an **unsecured loan of Rs 34.78 crore** and extinguishing that much of the subsidiary's debt.

**Shanti Gold International** — approves buying 1,44,817 shares of **Lalithaa Jewellery Mart on the secondary market for Rs 3.88 crore**, at a weighted average Rs 265.76 including brokerage and taxes.
**Millworks Technologies** — takes **67% of Vidwan Aeronautics**, an aerospace engine-components maker, by converting a **Rs 2.75 crore** loan into 15,22,727 shares at Rs 18.05, with no cash outflow.

**Eco Recycling** — the ERI-Ecoreco partnership and the proposed **"ERI India"** venture with ERI of the United States are formally announced in Tokyo; no consideration, shareholding or timetable is stated.
**Park Medi World** — incorporates a wholly owned SPV, **Park Medicity Prayagraj**, subscribing Rs 0.15 crore for 100%, to build and run the 550-bed Prayagraj PPP hospital it won on 26 August.
capex_core: **Apollo Pipes** — its board approves an **investment plan of up to Rs 300 crore** to set up subsidiaries entering the tiles and ceramics business, including by acquiring operating manufacturers _(~10.8% of mcap)_.

**Aster DM Quality Care** — material subsidiary KIMS Health approves a **Rs 134.4 crore new block at KIMSHEALTH Trivandrum**, adding about 184 beds to 979 by May 2028, funded 70% by debt _(~0.2% of mcap)_.
**Brigade Enterprises** — enters Coimbatore with a **5.4-acre residential joint development at Saravanampatti**, of an estimated Rs 600 crore gross development value.
**GHCL** — begins **commercial production of vacuum salt** at its Sutrapada soda-ash plant in Gujarat from 31 August, an annual capacity of 1.7 lakh tonnes that harnesses the plant's surplus energy.

**Active Clothing** — expands knitwear capacity, contracting **Ningbo Cixing of China for 106 computerised flat knitting machines** for its sweater division and simultaneously enlarging its circular-knits T-shirt division.
**Vraj Iron and Steel** — MoEF&CC transfers the **environmental clearance** for its proposed greenfield expansion at Chapka, Bastar, Chhattisgarh from Gopal Sponge & Power to the company.

**Ceigall India** — wholly owned Ceigall Green Energy MH2 commissions its **first 5 MW solar plant** at Ranjangaon Deshmukh, Maharashtra under MSKVY 2.0, ahead of schedule and so eligible for the incentive.

**Tata Power** — Tata Power Renewables commissions a **100 MW group-captive solar project** at Kayathar, Tamil Nadu, taking operational capacity past 7 GW and its utility portfolio to 12.3 GW; no value is stated.
business_updates: **Results season** — 10 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Zydus Lifesciences** — its **EVIDENCES-X Phase II(b) trial of Saroglitazar Mg in MASH** meets its primary endpoint, resolution of steatohepatitis with no worsening of fibrosis, at a treatment difference of 26.5% over 52 weeks.
**Cipla** — signs an **exclusive licensing agreement with SBP Group** for Rolditamig Deuderuxtecan (TQB2102), a HER2 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate; the covering letter states no consideration.

**Aurobindo Pharma** — step-down subsidiary Lannett launches the **generic of GSK's Advair Diskus** in 100/50 and 250/50 mcg strengths in the US, the first product from its inhalation pipeline to be commercialised there.
**SJVN** — completes the **72-hour trial run of the 660 MW Unit-2 of its 1,320 MW Buxar thermal power project** in Bihar.
**Karur Vysya Bank** — opens **16 branches in a single day** across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Delhi NCR, taking its network to 919.
**Cantabil Retail India** — opens **seven showrooms during August**, taking its store count to 682.
**Brandman Retail** — opens **ANTA's debut India store in Gurgaon** and doubles its India store target for the brand to 22, with 150 stores named as the longer-term ambition.
**Axis Solutions** — executes **three Power Control Centre E-House systems for Siemens Energy India**; the filing states no value.
**Jindal Worldwide** — subsidiary **Jindal Mobilitric will expand to 100 showrooms by FY28**, the company says, extending its electric-vehicle retail footprint nationwide.
**C.E. Info Systems (MapmyIndia)** — partners with ClarityX to launch **Geo-FI**, a geo-intelligence stack that brings spatial data into BFSI lending decisions.
**Coforge** — unveils its **AI Adoption Fabric**, a framework it positions for outcome acceleration in enterprise AI programmes.
**Vintage Coffee and Beverages** — adds a **roast-and-ground coffee segment**, installing a roaster and targeting the United States and Europe as part of its premiumisation push.
distress_risk: **Sanofi India** — a **show-cause notice under Section 74 of the CGST Act** alleging products were misclassified at 5% instead of 12% in 2020-21, proposing tax of Rs 36.39 crore and an equal penalty.

**Embassy Developments** — **Canara Bank appeals to the Supreme Court** against the 4 May NCLAT order that went in the company's favour; no stay has been granted and the hearing is listed for 24 September.

**Nephrocare Health Services** — its wholly owned Uzbek subsidiary receives a **tax-audit order from the Tashkent City Tax Department** covering 2023 to 2025, assessing additional tax and imposing a penalty.
**Indegene** — an update on the **class action under the US Telephone Consumer Protection Act** against wholly owned Indegene, Inc. in the District of New Jersey, continuing its 19 August disclosure.
**MT Educare** — files a Regulation 30 disclosure of **defaults on repayment of principal and interest** on term loans from banks and financial institutions.
**Race Eco Chain** — receives a **demand cum show-cause notice** dated 29 August from the Principal Commissioner of Central GST, Noida.
**Innovative Tyres & Tubes** — receives a **GST notice** from the office of the Commissioner, Vadodara, disclosed as an action initiated against the company.

**Flair Writing Industries** — discloses a **show-cause notice under Section 73 of the CGST Act** from the State Tax Officer, Valsad, continuing the GST scrutiny for FY 2022-23 it first intimated in February 2025.
**Parsvnath Developers** — its resolution professional convenes the **third Committee of Creditors meeting on 2 September**.
**Punj Lloyd** — the first meeting of its **reconstituted Committee of Creditors, on 2 September**, will discuss the way forward on closing the liquidation.
other_notable: **PVR INOX** — a **Rs 300 crore tender-offer buyback of up to 20,68,965 shares at Rs 1,450**, 2.11% of capital, with 4 September as the record date; the promoter group intends to participate _(~2.5% of mcap)_.

**Great Eastern Shipping** — publishes the statutory **public announcement for the Rs 900 crore open-market buyback** at up to Rs 1,530 a share that its board approved on **27 August**; at least Rs 675 crore must be deployed.
**IVP** — the Bombay High Court **quashes the Mumbai Port Authority's rent revisions and retrospective demands** from 2012 to March 2024, in the writ petition the company filed in 2022.
**Shiva Texyarn** — CARE **upgrades its long-term bank facilities to BBB+ (Stable)**, on a limit enhanced to Rs 98.08 crore from Rs 80.99 crore, with the short-term rating at A2.
**Indo Borax & Chemicals** — India Ratings moves its **BBB+ bank-facility rating from a Stable outlook to Rating Watch with Negative Implications**, with the A2+ short-term rating likewise on watch.
**Life Insurance Corporation of India** — launches two products for sale from 7 September, **Bima Platinum**, a non-par savings plan, and **Jeevan Raksha**, a pure risk plan.
**Bondada Engineering** — files the annual secretarial compliance report required to **migrate its equity shares from the BSE SME board to the main board**.
**Meenakshi India** — its board approves a **sub-division of equity shares from a face value of Rs 10 to Rs 5**.

**Blue Cloud Softech Solutions** — a technology association with the Mahesh Babu Foundation launches **GMB Life**, a preventive-screening and wellness application running on the company's BluHealth platform.
open_offers: **Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri Limited** — GRT Jewellers (India) Private Limited open offer for 25.88% (1.73 cr shares) at Rs 249.61 vs CMP 480.85 (-48.1%); SPA Rs 209 for 74.12%; change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); no delisting intent; **DO NOT TENDER - market pays more than the offer**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 3,209 cr

**Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters Ltd** — Misun Pure Lights Private Limited open offer for 10.04% (63.48 lakh shares) at Rs 14 vs CMP 12.89 (+8.6%); change of control (Reg 4) + >25% acquisition (Reg 3(1)); **TENDER - offer above market**; tender window not in PA (comes with DPS/LoF); mcap Rs 8 cr
